title: AntiFan Fixer Tool Surface Data
description: Shape of the fixer tool surface: the names a request permits and the patterns it forbids. This file declares the shape only. The pattern lists themselves are executable policy and live in exactly one place, .canary/tools/fix-loop/audits.mjs (DEFAULT_PERMITTED_TOOLS and DEFAULT_FORBIDDEN_TOOLS), which the merge gate, the contract validator, and the pre-tool hook all import. A second copy here would be a list that nobody enforces.

allowedTools.description: Exhaustive allowlist of tool names permitted for the fixer worker. Policy value: DEFAULT_PERMITTED_TOOLS in audits.mjs.

forbiddenToolPatterns.description: Pattern matcher forms (with wildcards) of tools forbidden for the fixer worker. Policy value: DEFAULT_FORBIDDEN_TOOLS in audits.mjs. Enforcement levers: the session capability name filter, the pre-tool hook guard, and the merge gate's declared-surface audit.
